process.title: How it supports each stage of the procurement process
process.description: A procurement process brings together dozens of documents that must be consistent with each other. Humanika reads them alongside your team; decisions remain with your organization.

stages.label: Planning
stages.title: Complete preliminary studies
stages.text: Checks that preliminary studies include what the procurement manual requires (need, purpose, budget, market analysis and risks) and flags what is missing before they are filed.

stages.label: Tender
stages.title: A clear, consistent tender
stages.text: Cross-checks the tender against the preliminary studies, annexes and addenda, and flags ambiguous, duplicated or contradictory requirements that often lead to objections or a void process.

stages.label: Observations
stages.title: Organized answers to bidders
stages.text: Groups the observations received by topic and tender section and prepares draft answers for the team to review within the schedule's deadlines.

stages.label: Evaluation
stages.title: Bid checking with evidence
stages.text: Compares each bid against the requirements matrix, shows where each supporting document is and what is missing or inconsistent, so the evaluation committee can request corrections and sign its report with more confidence.

highlights.title: What your organization gains
items: Fewer hours of manual reading of tender documents, annexes and bids.
Consistent requirements across preliminary studies, tender and addenda.
Every finding with the exact reference to its source document.
An evaluation committee that decides with organized information.
Aligned with Colombia Compra Eficiente's Procurement Manual, which promotes institutional intelligence tools in public purchasing.
Humanika does not award or decide: the team validates and signs every document.
